purpose: Directly measure residual joint-angle and motor-torque oscillation. Diagnostic screens, not certified limits or a detection holdout.
screen: Per axis and per signal: quiet terminal baseline must be below absolute RMS limits. For matched forced-minus-control trajectories, late band RMS must be <= absolute limit and <= max(half the early RMS, one tenth of the absolute limit). An under-excited pair cannot count as a pass. Peak absolute matched joint error in final 50 samples of the post-pulse window is separately screened. Original saturation/divergence are independent checks, never cleared by this vibration screen.
limits: The finite 15-150 Hz windows do not exclude slower oscillation, high-frequency chatter above band, other configurations or instability on hardware. During transport, subtracting a same-input unforced baseline removes taught motion but does not make the dynamics time invariant. Rest probes the returned, released arm, not an 8kg suspended static hold.
